statement: Minimise or maximise a single objective over bounded sliders with derivative-free local solvers (COBYLA and BOBYQA style) that converge quickly on smooth problems.
superiority: Dino 8 offers the local solvers with analytic stopping tolerances and constraint support, and returns convergence traces.

acceptance.corpus: Convex quadratic and Rosenbrock 2-D to 10-D from 10 random starts
acceptance.tolerance: Quadratic converges to f <= 1e-8 in <= 500 evaluations; Rosenbrock 2-D to f <= 1e-6 in <= 2,000

acceptance.corpus: Sphere with box bounds hitting the boundary
acceptance.tolerance: Solution lies on the bound within 1e-9

notes: Official Goat pages (Food4Rhino, Grasshopper group) were not reachable; outcomes come from McNeel forum threads, the COIN-OR Cup news item, and search-engine summaries. The solver list is not confirmed from a primary component reference.

statement: Search globally for the best objective value with derivative-free global solvers such as DIRECT, and stop reliably.

source.ref: Goat global solvers (DIRECT, controlled random search)

superiority: Dino 8 guarantees that max-evaluations, max-time and tolerance stop conditions are honoured promptly, which was reported unreliable in the plugin.

acceptance.corpus: Branin and Rastrigin 5-D with 20,000 evaluation budget
acceptance.tolerance: Branin global minimum within 1e-3; Rastrigin f <= 5
Run ends at or before 1,001 evaluations in 100% of trials

notes: Official Goat pages (Food4Rhino, Grasshopper group) were not reachable; outcomes come from McNeel forum threads, the COIN-OR Cup news item, and search-engine summaries. acceptance.tolerance: Reports all 3 local minima via multi-start
